compiled_state.title: RED: integrate ProvenanceLedger into differ.compute_mutations with echo suppression
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: echo suppression — write on pass N produces zero mutations on pass N+1

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_echo_suppression.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] compute_mutations suppresses mutations for hash-identical elements across all 10 element classes
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_echo_suppression.py::test_echo_suppressed_for_identical_elements
- [ ] Two-pass simulation: pass 1 applies, pass 2 against post-apply state emits zero mutations
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_echo_suppression.py::test_zero_mutations_on_followon_pass
- [ ] Existing differ tests still pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_differ_conflict_resolution.py

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/differ.py compute_mutations(local_state, jira_state). This signature is owned by sibling story cde1-30ba — already declared as a story-level depends_on. Sprint MUST NOT dispatch T3 before cde1-30ba closes; if cde1's signature differs from (local_state, jira_state), surface the discrepancy via /dso:fix-cascade-recovery rather than silently adapting.

Implementation:
- Instantiate fresh ProvenanceLedger() at pass start (no persistence across passes).
- For each element under consideration, call ledger.is_echo(class, id, local_value, jira_value); SKIP mutation emission if True.
- Thread the ledger into resolve_field calls so per-element provenance is recorded.
- Discard ledger at pass end.

Echo invariant is content-hash equality across sides on the CURRENT pass — not cross-pass history. Pass N+1 sees both sides identical → suppress. Pass N+1 with new edit on one side → sides differ → emit.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): DISPATCH GATE — sprint orchestrator MUST verify cde1-30ba-d186-48d2 status==closed before dispatching T3. The current differ.py:36-39 takes (prev_snapshot, next_snapshot) — TWO TIMEPOINTS, ONE SIDE. is_echo requires (local_value, jira_value) — TWO SIDES — which cde1's redesigned compute_mutations(local_state, jira_state) provides. Without cde1's redesign there is no surface to attach the ledger to. /dso:fix-cascade-recovery is post-hoc; replace with a precondition check. If precondition fails: BLOCK T3 (do not dispatch with degraded signature; do not improvise).
